mechanism_narrative: High inflation, as measured by CPIAUCSL above 200, consistently erodes corporate profit margins and increases risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 200 and 20d forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tight monetary policy that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and 20d forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) creates a 'tight money' environment that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% AND CPIAUCSL > 200 and 20d forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing bust cycle (HOUST < 1350 and RSAFS < 365000), declining housing starts and residential fixed investment reduce consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1350 AND RSAFS < 365000 and 20d forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% and 5d forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) and declining labor force participation (PAYEMS < 138000) indicates a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% AND PAYEMS < 138000 and 60d forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO < 100) consistently indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and 60d forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 1350 thousand units signals a housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1350 and 5d forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.
